records.issue_text: The _* regex in English-file derivation starts matching at the first underscore, so multi-underscore filenames like messages_messages_de.properties are silently mapped to the wrong English file, producing false 'Illegal HTML' failures
records.rationale:
In VerifyMessageProperties.verifySafeHtml(), the English filename is derived via:
`replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties", "_en.properties")`.
Because the character class `[a-zA-Z-_]*` includes `_`, this regex can match from the *first* underscore in a multi-underscore filename. E.g. `messages_messages_de.properties` would match `_messages_de.properties` and be rewritten to `messages_en.properties` instead of `messages_messages_en.properties`, leading to comparing against the wrong English source and potentially reporting spurious "Illegal HTML" differences.
records.stripped_text: The _* regex in English-file derivation starts matching at the first underscore, so multi-underscore filenames like messages_messages_de.properties are silently mapped to the wrong English file, producing false 'Illegal HTML' failures
